title: Closed-form Bayesian quantum estimation of Gaussian states
summary: Bayesian quantum estimation provides a robust formalism for quantum technologies, particularly in scenarios with limited data and minimal prior information. Yet, its application to continuous-variable systems has remained limited and largely numerical due to the difficulty of the underlying parameter integrals. Here, we introduce a variational framework that restricts the optimisation over all measurements and estimators to a finite-dimensional subspace, reducing the problem to a linear system of equations with closed-form solutions.
